scientific_integrity: An all-parameter analytic proof is given; seven finite examples are independent corroboration rather than an exhaustive classification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple affine resolvable 2-designs with constant positive cross-parallel-class block intersections, in two-sorted incidence-only non-counting FO3; not all resolvable designs or counting/richer signatures. Historical priority and independent mathematical audit not established.
title: Two unrestricted three-variable theories of affine resolvable designs
